Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When changing lanes, you should never:

options_en.text: Change lanes while inside an intersection.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: If your car's rear end starts skidding to the left, you should:

options_en.text: Steer to the right.
Steer to the left.
Tap your brakes lightly and shift into neutral.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: No U-turn.
No left turn.
No right turn.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: The best way to avoid a dangerous situation while driving is to:

options_en.text: Stay aware of what is happening around your vehicle.
Turn off the radio.
Always keep your eyes focused ahead of your car.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: If a child is about to run into the street, you should:

options_en.text: Begin to slow down.
Flash your headlights.
Sound a sharp blast of your horn.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Which describes a defensive driver's thinking?

options_en.text: Other drivers will do the right thing.
They think about what other drivers might do and are ready to react.
They expect no courtesy and give none.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When entering the interstate, find a gap in traffic, match the traffic speed, signal, and:

options_en.text: Expect traffic to make room for you since you have the right-of-way.
Merge carefully into the gap.
Wait for the lane to clear completely before merging.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When stopping on snow or ice in a vehicle with Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS), you should:

options_en.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
Avoid the brakes and let the car slow down naturally.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: You are in the left lane with two lanes going your direction. Many cars are passing you on the right. If a driver behind you wants to go faster, you should:

options_en.text: Stay in your lane so you don't slow down traffic.
Drive onto the left shoulder to let cars pass.
Move into the right lane when it is safe.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: You should always travel at:

options_en.text: The speed of cars around you.
The speed limit.
A speed that fits the road and weather conditions.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Excessive speed:

options_en.text: Does not increase the chance of a crash.
Helps you react faster to danger.
Often leads to risky decisions.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: If you are under 21, your license can be suspended if you drive with a blood alcohol level of:

options_en.text: 0.15 percent or more.
0.08 percent or more.
Any amount.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: On a highway with a dashed white line between lanes:

options_en.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When you see a flashing red light at an intersection, you must:

options_en.text: Stop completely, yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go.
Slow down and proceed carefully.
Stop and stay stopped while the light is red.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: Watch for bicycles.
Bicycles not allowed.
Bicycle repair shop ahead.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: Get ready. Traffic will merge into your lane.
Always stop.
A divided highway is ahead.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: If you park facing uphill where there is no curb, set the parking brake and:

options_en.text: Turn your wheels toward the edge of the road.
Turn your wheels away from the edge of the road.
Keep your wheels facing straight.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Broken yellow lines are used on streets and highways to:

options_en.text: Mark no passing zones.
Separate lanes moving in the same direction.
Separate lanes moving in opposite directions.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Water on the road can cause hydroplaning. Your car may hydroplane at speeds as low as:

options_en.text: 45 miles per hour.
35 miles per hour.
40 miles per hour.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When merging onto a freeway, you should drive:

options_en.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
5 to 10 mph slower than freeway traffic.
At the posted speed limit for the freeway.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When changing lanes:

options_en.text: Use only your rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
Use only your left side mirror.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: When using a roundabout, drivers should:

options_en.text: Let entering traffic go first.
Let traffic already in the roundabout go first.
Drive clockwise around the circle.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: A divided highway is ending.
A divided highway is beginning.
The road will be slippery ahead.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Highway pavement is most slippery:

options_en.text: When it has been raining for several hours.
When rain just starts.
When it has been raining for 1 to 2 hours.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: To avoid glare from oncoming headlights:

options_en.text: Look briefly toward the right side of the road.
Keep your eyes on the center line of the road.
Flash your high beams.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: If dust or smoke makes it hard to see other vehicles, drive slowly and turn on your:

options_en.text: Emergency flashers.
Parking lights.
Headlights.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: To turn quickly, place your hands:

options_en.text: On opposite sides of the steering wheel.
Next to each other on top of the steering wheel.
On the top and bottom of the steering wheel.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Which statement is true about roadwork zones?

options_en.text: Traffic fines in work zones are the same as normal fines.
You must slow down for work zones.
Slow down only if you see workers present.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: Give right-of-way to pedestrians who are:

options_en.text: In a marked crosswalk.
In any crosswalk or intersection.
Crossing any street.

Rules, Safety, & Procedures Quiz.question_en: In rainy weather, be most careful when turning or stopping:

options_en.text: After it has rained all day.
A half hour after rain stops.
During the first half hour of rain.
